Breaking Records: Our Placement Success Story

We are proud to announce that our institution has achieved record-breaking placement results for the 2025-2026 academic year. Our students have emerged as top performers in the campus recruitment drive, securing positions with some of the most prestigious companies in the world.

Key Highlights

  • 100% Placement Rate: All graduating students secured positions
  • Highest Package: Rs. 18 LPA
  • Average Package: Rs. 8.5 LPA
  • Multiple Offers: 45% of students accepted multiple offers
  • Top Recruiters: Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan

Student Success Stories

Our students have demonstrated exceptional skills and dedication. From computer science to management graduates, everyone has found their career path with leading organizations. The diverse range of placements across various sectors—IT, Finance, Consulting, and more—reflects the quality of education and personality development we provide.

Company Recognition

Top companies have consistently chosen our graduates for their work ethic, technical knowledge, and professional demeanor. The feedback from recruiters has been overwhelmingly positive, with many companies requesting larger batches for future placements.

Our Commitment

These outstanding results are a testament to the hard work of our students, dedicated faculty, and comprehensive placement support system. We continue to focus on holistic development, ensuring our graduates are industry-ready and capable of making significant contributions to their organizations and society.
